# yardang

> Easily generate sphinx documentation

## Pages

- [yardang](index.html.md): yardang is a Python library for generating Sphinx documentation easily, with minimal local configuration overhead.
- [Overview](docs/src/overview.html.md): yardang is a tool to configure the most common Sphinx options directly from a pyproject.toml. Sphinx relies on a conf.py file and Makefiles, but these usuall...
- [Installation](docs/src/installation.html.md): You can install from PyPI via pip:
- [Configuration](docs/src/configuration.html.md): Configuration for yardang is driven from the pyproject.toml, either via standard sections like project or from the dedicated tool.yardang section. Each optio...
- [Example Notebook](docs/notebooks/example.html.md): This is an example notebook.
- [API Reference](docs/src/api.html.md): Generate Sphinx documentation configuration from pyproject.toml.
- [Calculator C++ API Documentation](examples/cpp/docs/api.html.md): This page demonstrates how to use breathe to document C++ code with yardang.

- [Struct calculator::ScientificCalculator](api/crates/calculator/structs/calculator::ScientificCalculator.html.md): A scientific calculator with additional mathematical functions.
